summary: The filing is an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events report by Senior Credit Investments, LLC declaring a routine cash distribution of $16.7252 per unit payable on May 18, 2026 to unitholders of record April 30, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The distribution is a standard periodic payout for a credit-focused LLC and does not constitute a special situation.
